'''Prep:''' 15 minutes
'''Cooking:''' 40 minutes | Difficulty = 2 | Image = [[Image:Santiago.IMG 9780.JPG|300px]] | Rating = 2 }}{{Recipe}} '''Tarta de Santiago''' is a [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Spain|Spanish]] [[Cookbook:almond|almond]] cake from Galicia. It is an easy cake to make, with only 3 main ingredients, and it is well-suited for the holiday season.{{Cite web |title=Tarta De Santiago {{!}} Public Domain Recipes |url=https://publicdomainrecipes.com/tarta-de-santiago/ |access-date=2024-12-04 |website=publicdomainrecipes.com}} This cake is dusted with icing sugar, with an imprint of Santiago’s cross on its top surface. ==Ingredients== *3 [[Cookbook:egg|eggs]] *¾ [[Cookbook:cup|cup]] (150 [[Cookbook:gram|g]]) white granulated [[Cookbook:sugar|sugar]] *[[Cookbook:Zest|Zest]] of 1 [[Cookbook:lemon|lemon]] *Zest of 1 [[Cookbook:clementine|clementine]] *1½ cup (150 g) [[Cookbook:Almond Meal|almond meal]] *½ [[Cookbook:teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:cinnamon|cinnamon]] powder *¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:salt|salt]] *[[Cookbook:Icing sugar|Icing sugar]] ==Equipment== *[[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|Mixing bowl]] *[[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] *Rubber [[Cookbook:Spatula|spatula]] *7-inch (18 cm) [[Cookbook:Springform Pan|springform pan]] *[[Cookbook:Oven|Oven]] ==Procedure== # Add eggs and sugar to a bowl, and whisk rapidly until mixture turns pale. # Whisk in the citrus zests. # Combine the almond meal, cinnamon, and salt in a separate bowl. Transfer to the egg mixture, and use a rubber spatula to gently [[Cookbook:Fold|fold]] everything together until well combined. # Butter and flour the springform pan, then pour in the batter. Smooth the top if necessary. # [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in preheated oven at 360ºF (180ºC) for 40 minutes or until golden brown and fully cooked in the center. # Cool completely, and unmold the cake. # Place a Santiago cross cut-out on top of the cake, then [[Cookbook:Dusting|dust]] generous amount of icing sugar all over cake. # Carefully remove the cross cut-out. Slice and serve. ==Notes, tips, and variations== * One can also make an imprint of a scallop shell or no imprint at all on top of the cake. ==References== [[Category:Recipes for cake]] [[Category:Spanish recipes]] [[Category:Holiday recipes]] [[Category:Recipes using almond flour]] [[Category:Recipes using egg]] [[Category:Recipes using lemon zest]] [[Category:Recipes using cinnamon]] [[Category:Recipes using powdered sugar]] [[Category:Recipes using white sugar]]

Cool completely, and unmold the cake.
Place a Santiago cross cut-out on top of the cake, then dust generous amount of icing sugar all over cake.
